verdict.rationale: Virtualization and container support is a fair question for a developer-facing laptop chip, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only AI, GPU, Metal, and spec claims. Nothing documents hardware virtualization, hypervisor frameworks, or Docker workflows on M5. The one passing mention of VMs (apple-m5-comm-5) is a user's RAM-usage anecdote, not evidence that M5 supports or runs VMs well.

support.subject: As a developer, VMs and containers run well on this silicon — documented virtualization support and mainstream hypervisor and Docker workflows
